newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: MOZAMBIQUE ARRESTS THREE AFTER SMUGGLER'S DEATH.
newsitem.headline: MOZAMBIQUE ARRESTS THREE AFTER SMUGGLER'S DEATH.

text.p: Three men are been held for questioning in connection with the smuggling of cocaine into Mozambique after the Nigerian courier, who had swallowed the drug, died this week, police in Maputo said on Saturday.
The three were said by the police to be a Malawian, a Namibian and a citizen of the Central African Republic.
The dead Nigerian was named as Raphael Amalakwe, who arrived in Maputo from Brazil on Wednesday.
On arrival he was already in a coma and he died in Maputo Central Hospital on Thursday.
Doctors found 54 capsules of cocaine, weighing a total of about 1.6 kilos, in his stomach, the police said. Some of the capsules had burst open and Amalakwe died of a cocaine overdose.
Mozambique has a reputation as a conduit for the international drug trade. Police said they believed South Africa was the intended destination of the latest cocaine haul.
